title: Framed null curves and timelike surfaces via Lorentzian harmonic maps into de-Sitter 2-space
summary: We construct a class of Lorentzian harmonic maps into the de-Sitter $2$-space satisfying the eigenvalue equation $\Box N=2H^2N$ for the d'Alambert operator $\Box$ and a non-zero constant $H$ from framed null curves. We also investigate two classes of timelike surfaces associated with these Lorentzian harmonic maps: the first one is timelike surfaces with constant mean curvature $H$ in Lorentz-Minkowski $3$-space and the second one is timelike minimal surfaces in the three-dimensional Lorentzian Heisenberg group $\operatorname{Nil}_3(H)$.
